version.reason: The last version before `blobhash` exists; iterating targets shows the name is free on every target, so the language-version gate alone decides it. Constantinople through Shanghai match solc exactly; the divergences below are all target-support artefacts of 0.8.23, unrelated to `blobhash`.

expected_solc_divergence.reason: solc 0.8.23 declines the Frontier target outright ('Invalid EVM version requested'), which counts as a rejection, while slang accepts the declaration. Unrelated to `blobhash`.

Cancun support only arrives in solc 0.8.24, so 0.8.23 declines these targets with 'Invalid EVM version requested', which counts as a rejection. slang accepts the declaration, which is the point of this test: at 0.8.23 `blobhash` is not a global on any target. The sibling `yul_variable_shadows_blobhash` test pins 0.8.24 and covers the Cancun boundary against a solc that supports it.
